_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Udibana neGolf (iGame yaKadi) - Mdlali {player_id}.
Injongo: Ukupata iskore elincinci kwi round eyodwa. Iikholoni zifana ngokuthi zinceda kuwe 0.
Iivali zekadi: A=1, 2-10=ivali, J/Q=10, K=0

Izithenda (sebenzisa brackets zexakwe):
- '[draw]' - Dibana kwiideki
- '[take]' - Thatha kwiidibanisi
- '[swap X Y]' - Switcha ikadi edibene neni X (ifa) Y (kolumi)
- '[discard]' - Thintiba ikadi edibene

board.drew:
Wadibene: {card}
Kunxachenxe ukuba [swap X Y] noma [discard]
board.took:
Wadibene: {card} kudibanisi
Kunxachenxe ukuba [swap X Y] nayo (angadibangi)

options.final_turns: Izithatha zokugcina! Izixhobo zakho: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: You must: [swap X Y] (cannot discard cards from discard pile)

message.deck_empty: Umgangatho awunanto! Umdlalo uphela ngoko nangoko.
message.knocked: Umdlali {pid} unqanyulwe! Omnye umdlali ngamnye ufumana ithuba elinye.
message.final_round: Mdlali {pid} {reason}! Bonke abadlali bangaphandle bafuna uthatha nanye

invalid.wrong_action: Sebenzisa enye iactionDate: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], noma [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Awunakho ukulahla ikhadi elithatyathwe kwiqela lokulahla. Kufuneka ulitshintshe.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Unedibene edibene. Kunxachenxe ukuba [swap X Y] noma [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_discard: You need a drawn card to discard.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Indawo ikaphaya kwezigidigidi. Sebenzisa ifa 1-{max_row}, kolumi 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Awukwazi ukubetha ngekhadi elitshixiweyo. Qalisa kuqala ngokutshintsha kwakho.
invalid.already_knocked: Umntu othile sele embethe lo mjikelo.
